contentBlocks.text: ਕੱਲ੍ਹ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਪੜਨਾਂਵ ਸਿੱਖੇ। ਅੱਜ: ਇੱਕ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਚੀਜ਼ਾਂ ਲਈ ਸ਼ਬਦ ਕਿਵੇਂ ਬਦਲਦੇ ਹਨ! (Yesterday you learned pronouns. Today: how words change for more than one thing!)

Just like English changes 'girl' to 'girls,' Punjabi nouns change for plural (more than one) too: ਕੁੜੀ (one girl) becomes ਕੁੜੀਆਂ (girls). ਮੁੰਡਾ (one boy) becomes ਮੁੰਡੇ (boys). ਕਿਤਾਬ (one book) becomes ਕਿਤਾਬਾਂ (books). Practice: change ਬੱਚਾ (one child) into its plural form, ਬੱਚੇ (children).
ਤੁਸੀਂ ਬਹੁਵਚਨ ਸਿੱਖਿਆ! (You just learned plurals!) Tomorrow we'll combine pronouns and plurals into full sentences.

objectives: Understand that Punjabi nouns change form for plural (more than one)
Correctly change 4 nouns from singular to plural: ਕੁੜੀ/ਮੁੰਡਾ/ਕਿਤਾਬ/ਬੱਚਾ
teacherGuide.facilitationScript:
1. Review yesterday's pronouns briefly.
2. Introduce plural nouns using the ਕੁੜੀ/ਕੁੜੀਆਂ example.
3. Have the child change ਬੱਚਾ to ਬੱਚੇ independently.
4. Complete the worksheet.
5. Preview tomorrow's sentence-combining lesson.
differentiationTips: Struggling: practice just one singular/plural pair (ਕੁੜੀ/ਕੁੜੀਆਂ) until it's solid before introducing the other three
Ready for more: ask the child to think of one more noun they know and guess its plural form
Punjabi plural endings aren't perfectly uniform across all nouns — keep this lesson to the 4 taught examples rather than generalizing a single rule
teacherGuide.answerKey: This is a vocabulary-transformation activity — check that the child correctly writes ਬੱਚੇ as the plural of ਬੱਚਾ, and can recall the other 3 singular/plural pairs.
teacherGuide.standardsRationale: Directly addresses the course's 'grammar basics' goal, introducing noun pluralization as a genuinely new grammar concept beyond week 1.

generationData.instructions: Write the plural form of each noun.
